name: Ambiguous customer communication
description: The CRM shows a potential follow-up gap, while a recent customer communication may be relevant but is too ambiguous to determine whether it concerns the quote.

primary_only.interpretation: Potential follow-up gap based on the quote follow-up baseline.

cross_system.interpretation: The opportunity may require follow-up, but the recent communication is ambiguous and cannot reliably be treated as quote-related evidence.

expected.recommendation: Verify the communication context before taking action.
